Commentary: Nathan Smith to Tilak Varma, FOUR, short ball, Tilak swivels across, pulls it behind square and there's no one in the deep to cut it off. What a turnaround this is - just 17 needed now off 8 balls. Slipping away from New Zealand at the death
Nathan Smith to Tilak Varma, no run, comes charging down the pitch but ends up getting yorked by Smith who slants it away and beats him on the way to the keeper

Nathan Smith to Tilak Varma, SIX, the Indian players are on their feet in the dugout! They know all about what Tilak Varma can do and are watching another fine display from the left-hander here. Nerves of steel this guy. Slower length ball angled away wide of off, he hangs back, reaches out and slaps it over wide long-off for a remarkable six
Jacob Duffy to Nitish Reddy, 1 run, banged in short, Reddy pulls hard but it goes straight to deep midwicket on the bounce

Jacob Duffy to Tilak Varma, FOUR, full and wide, misses with his execution and Tilak absolutely blasts it away through extra cover. Might've been going for the wide yorker but ended up offering it right in the slot

Jacob Duffy to Tilak Varma, 2 runs, banged in short outside off, rushes Tilak on the pull and he mistimes it down to long-on. He was taking it a little easy on the second run, thinking the throw won't come to his end but then turned around and realised he had to put in the dive to make it back. Fifty up for him, job not done though
Jacob Duffy to Tilak Varma, 1 run, again he goes short outside off, Tilak doesn't get hold of it, cuts it in the air but it lands short of sweeper cover. Over to Reddy

Jacob Duffy to Nitish Reddy, wide, another bumper, goes past the attempted ramp, beating Reddy for pace but hang on ... the striker's end umpire feels it's too high. She spreads her arms to signal a wide. 2 needed off 2 - Duffy shakes his head as he walks back. Reddy was immediately asking for a wide and was searching to see where the umpire was. He looked at square leg but the ump was at point, giving the decision in his favour

Jacob Duffy to Nitish Reddy, 2 runs, remarkable turnaround here in Christchurch as India go 2-0 up in the series! Tilak Varma and Nitish Reddy the heroes for the visitors as they come back from nowhere to seal the win. Full toss on the pads, it's flicked away into the gap and they get back for two as the crowd erupts
